newsitem.title: USA: Chevron Calif. FCC seen shut through Dec. 25.
newsitem.headline: Chevron Calif. FCC seen shut through Dec. 25.

text.p: A key gasoline-making unit at Chevron Corp's 225,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Richmond, Calif., will remain shut until December 25 due to tubing problems, an industry source said.
"The fluid catalytic cracker (FCC) is down for a shutdown. We're supposed to be back up by Christmas," the source said, citing plugged tubing as the cause of the unplanned outage.
The unit shut Friday and the source said production of refined products has fallen at the plant, though no specifics were available.
